claims.evidence: Witness report confirms Yamaha branding/logo is visible, but does not show the exact model or any features that prove it is a 'professional' tier.
Witness report: large “YAMAHA” logo visible on the keyboard front in Photo 1 and Photo 2.

risks.risk: Exact model is not readable, so capability, key count, and typical market value are uncertain.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model name/number label (usually on the rear panel or underside) and the full front panel text.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case for an unverified Yamaha keyboard model (unknown specs), assuming average/entry condition until model is confirmed.

risks.risk: Unknown working status (may not power on, speakers may be faulty, keys may be unresponsive).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing power-on, volume/speaker output (or headphone output), and a quick test of several keys across the range.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possibly faulty until it demonstrates working sound and responsive keys.

risks.risk: Physical condition unknown beyond general appearance (missing/stuck keys, cracks, damaged stand).
risks.proof: A straight-on photo of the entire keybed plus close-ups of both ends and the stand joints; include a shot showing all keys in one frame.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for potential wear/damage (no guarantee of all keys/controls being perfect).

risks.risk: Missing or mismatched power adapter/charger could prevent use.
risks.proof: Photo of the included adapter/charger label (voltage/amp) and a clip showing it powering the keyboard.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming adapter may be missing or not guaranteed compatible.

risks.risk: Accessories and connectivity (sustain pedal, USB/MIDI, headphone jack, mic input) may be missing or non-functional.
risks.proof: Photos of all ports and included accessories, plus a quick test clip for at least one relevant port (e.g., headphone output or sustain pedal).
risks.if_unproven: Price without assuming accessories/ports are included or working.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the exact Yamaha model number/label (rear/underside) so the exact spec can be priced.
Short video showing the keyboard powering on and producing sound (speaker or headphone) with volume control working.
Video or photos showing key responsiveness (press a range of keys; show no stuck/missing keys).
Photo of the power adapter/charger label and confirmation it matches the keyboard; show it powering the unit.
Photos of all ports and any included accessories (sustain pedal, USB/MIDI, headphone jack, mic input if present).
response.reason: While Yamaha branding is visible, the exact model and working condition are not verifiable from the witness photos. Without a power-on/function test and model identification, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
